intentAlignment.reason: This Work Item is limited to the explicit release publication entrypoint, immutable tag identity preflight, and its own evidence-preserving lifecycle; Runtime protocol, product behavior, historical migration, and performance work remain out of scope.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A publication dispatch must carry an explicit Work Item identity and bind the tag, source commit, Contract, and workflow revision before any release job runs.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the cheap release input preflight with valid and invalid identity inputs and retain its structured receipt.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing, malformed, lightweight, moved, or ambiguous release inputs are rejected before compilation or publication.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise static policy and inspect the dispatch preflight guards; assert no release compilation job is eligible after rejection.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A tag push alone cannot start publication; only the explicit dispatch path can publish an identity-bound immutable tag.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run workflow and action runtime policies and inspect the hosted trigger configuration on the reviewed merge.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Publication retains candidate and public fresh-install, N-1 upgrade, handoff, attestation, and close barriers.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use one explicit v0.2.92 dispatch and retain the public artifact acceptance and close receipts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A failed dispatch resumes from the first invalid phase without rewriting the tag or Release and preserves all prior valid evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the release workflow recovery inputs and, if needed, use close-only or post-release recovery without rebuilding valid product artifacts.
